<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex45042024-08-2914-22-30" status="finalized"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5554">lha</rs> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5549">shag</rs> dang | <rs type="work" ref="db:5588" ana="corpusmd:named_reference">rgyan</rs> gyi dgongs pa <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5564"><expan>rigs</expan> gter</rs> las | <quote source="db:5564" n="VIII.40b"><l><expan>mi slu</expan> ma shes don gsal 2 ||</l> <l>rnam grangs pa'ang phye ste smra ||</l></quote> <!--RT VIII.40b, gzhan gyis brtag pa dgag na-->
               <expan>zhes gsung</expan> shing | de dgag pa yang | <quote source="db:5564" n="VIII.41ab"><l><expan>mtshan nyid</expan> 2 kyis 'jog na ni ||</l> <l>mtshon byed de yang 2 su 'gyur ||</l></quote> <!--VIII.41ab, agaisnt Lha dbang blo-->
               <quote source="db:5564" n="VIII.41cd"><l>mtshon bya <expan>gnyis su</expan> 'dod na yang ||</l><l>spyi mtshan 1 pa mi srid 'gyur ||</l></quote> <!--RT VIII.41cd, against rGyan mdzad pa-->
            <quote source="db:5564" n="VIII.42ab?"><l>tha snyad pa dang <expan>don dam</expan> pa ||</l> <l>2 ga la yang 2 po 'jug ||</l></quote> <note type="editorial">Different from VIII 42ab against Chos mchog, which reads: ma khyab gcod tshul 'dir mi 'thad || gnyis su 'byed pa dgongs pa min </note> ces dang | 
             <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5552">bram ze</rs>'i bzhed pa la yang | 
            <quote source="db:5564" n="VIII.42cd"><l>mi dgos ma khyab <expan>mi srid</expan> 3 ||</l> <l>bden pa'i don <expan>rtogs</expan> 'dod na yod ||</l></quote> <!--RT VIII.42cd, against Bram ze-->
            <expan>ces so</expan> ||</seg></TEI>
